text:
jamie: quick thought — can we try a lightweight incident lifecycle checkpoint playbook? e.g. mandatory check-ins at 2h, 24h, 72h, and 1 week after P1s. keeps remediations visible and avoids forgotten tickets.

sarah: +1. pockets of regressions have come from missing 72h followups. would love a small template we can paste into the postmortem.

rahul: love it. couple constraints: ops teams are overloaded; checkpoints need to be extremely actionable, not just 'check status'. propose a compact checklist: 1) current mitigations 2) owner for long-term remediation 3) blocker list 4) rollback risk.

maria: can we add a brief "recurrence signal" section? e.g., check alert history last 90 days + related recent deploys. if recurrence > 2, escalate to incident patterns board.

ben: suggest we pick a single place to track action items — e.g. a dedicated kanban column in our incident board (Jira/Linear). call it "Incident Checkpoints". update cadence: owner moves card and posts an update in thread.

jamie: agree on single source. also thinking about role rotation: rotate incident commander weekly, but add a shadow for the first two rotations for handoff continuity. shadow does the checklist next-step review.

rahul: rotation + shadow is good. can we automate owner reminders? oncall-bot could DM the owner at each checkpoint and also post a summary to the thread.

oncall-bot: automated reminder scheduled: owner @placeholder will receive DM at 2h, 24h, 72h for thread 1950123456. (this is a mock; PR for automation needed) :robot_face:

maria: small tempplate idea (pasteable):
```
Checkpoint: <2h / 24h / 72h / 1w>
Owner: @<name>
Status: (Mitigation / Investigating / Remediated / Monitoring)
Next steps: short bullets with owners and ETA
Recurrence check: last 90d incidents linked
Blockers: short list + who can unblock
Jira/Linear card: <link>
```

ben: can someone prototype the automation and template in a PR? I can sponsor the board change.

jamie: I will open a tiny RFC with the template + automation tasks. plan: pilot for 4 teams for 2 months, measure "stale action rate" reduction and recurrence flagging.

rahul: measurement ideas: percent of actions with no owner after 72h, time-to-remediation median, recurrence rate post-remediation. add to the ops dashboard.

maria: if pilot looks good, we should make this part of the postmortem closure gate: postmortem can't be moved to closed until 72h checkpoint exists and at least 1 followup action assigned.

jamie: noted. i'll draft RFC today and tag folks. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
